data.name: ReorderParameters_ChoiceDescription
data.value: The order of the parameters. Every call passes its arguments in that order.

data.name: ReorderParameters_NoProcedure
data.value: There is no procedure here whose parameters can be reordered.

data.name: ReorderParameters_OneParameter
data.value: '{0}' has fewer than two parameters to reorder.

data.name: ReorderParameters_NotDeclaredByWorkspace
data.value: '{0}' is not declared by the workspace: only what the workspace declares can be changed.

data.name: ReorderParameters_Event
data.value: '{0}' is an event: reordering the parameters of an event is not supported yet.

data.name: ReorderParameters_Handler
data.value: '{0}' handles an event, and takes the parameters of the event in their order: it keeps them.

data.name: ReorderParameters_ExternalProcedure
data.value: '{0}' is declared by its library: its parameters cannot be reordered.

data.name: ReorderParameters_Order
data.value: The new order must name each parameter of '{0}' once.

data.name: ReorderParameters_Optional
data.value: '{0}' is required, and would come after the optional parameter '{1}': optional parameters come last.

data.name: ReorderParameters_ParamArray
data.value: '{0}' is a ParamArray: it stays the last parameter.

data.name: ReorderParameters_Mismatched
data.value: The parameters of '{1}' are not those of the procedure it changes with: they cannot be reordered together.

data.name: ReorderParameters_Evaluated
data.value: The arguments of the call to '{0}' at {2} would be evaluated in another order, and they do more than read a value: the change can change what the code does.

data.name: ReorderParameters_LateBound
data.value: '{0}' may be called late-bound at {2}: the arguments passed there would not be reordered.

data.name: ReorderParameters_CalledByName
data.value: '{0}' is called by its name in a string at {2}: the arguments passed there would not be reordered.

data.name: ReorderParameters_Unresolved
data.value: What '{0}' refers to at {2} is not known: the change could miss it.

data.name: ReorderParameters_MayEvaluate
data.value: The call to '{0}' at {2} passes arguments that do more than read a value: an order that evaluates them in another order can change what the code does.
